2026-10-23-axel-agentic-workflow.title: AXEL Seminar: Agentic Workflows
2026-10-23-axel-agentic-workflow.description: Working with AI agents in three Episodes: onboard them every time, manage their attention span, and see why they add management work.

2026-10-28-cyberforum-akademie-intro-age.title: Generative AI at work
2026-10-28-cyberforum-akademie-intro-age.description: How does generative AI work, and how can it genuinely help at work? This interactive introduction gives you a mental model of how AI behaves, whatever the tool: big tasks split into steps, the AI works through them, and you stay captain in between. Prompting basics and meta-prompting come not as theory but as copy-ready prompts, and in the live demo "Grill me" the AI helps you find the right question first. To go deeper: the hands-on workshop on 16 November 2026 turns to concrete use cases.

2026-11-04-intro-hitl-workflows.title: Intro Human in the Loop Workflow
2026-11-04-intro-hitl-workflows.description: An introduction to human-in-the-loop workflows in Guangzhou.

2026-11-16-cyberforum-akademie-hands-on-.title: Hands-on workshop: Introduction to agentic workflows
2026-11-16-cyberforum-akademie-hands-on-.description: Agentic AI workflows open up a new way of working with AI: instead of single tasks, agents support whole workflows, question requirements, develop solutions on their own and accompany you through the build. In this hands-on workshop you learn the basics of agentic workflows and apply them straight away: how to define tasks precisely and steer agents through context engineering, working with a modern coding agent on your own questions. Prerequisite: a coding agent set up with a subscription, such as Claude Code or Codex CLI.
